[F004] All 361 tests across inbox/sanitization/notify/operator_console/state_projection/event_copy still pass with the F004 wiring in place. Implementation summary:

**Changes**:
- `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/state_projection.py:577` — promoted `_scrub_secrets` to public `scrub_secrets` per D020, kept the private name as a backward-compat alias, added to `__all__`.
- `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operator_console.py:786` — wired `_assert_no_secret_shapes(entry)` at the sidecar write boundary in `write_event_action_sidecar()`; raises `ValueError` before the JSONL append so a leaked secret rejects the persisted write.
- `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify_discord.py:_build_payload` + `_format_content` — substitute-mode scrubbing of title / detail / exact_command / evidence_uri / footer / legacy-content path before the Discord payload is assembled.
- `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify.py:notify_event` — scrubbing of title / message / subtitle before invoking the terminal-notifier shim.
- `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/inbox.py:append_rendered_annotation` — scrubbing of title / detail / exact_command / evidence_uri / per-tech values in the rendered markdown block.

**Tests**: new `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_event_messaging_sanitization_f004.py` — 66 cases covering the public-symbol promotion (D020), sidecar raise-mode (9 patterns × 1 = 9 raises), live-path no-raise (3 sinks × secret-bearing fixtures), full 9 × 4 = 36 matrix (9 patterns each scrubbed in Discord emb
